summary: Iteration 7 tested the mobile Kavip-style Checkout restyle at 400x850 and desktop regression at 1400x900. Authenticated the tester clerk user via Clerk sign-in-token ticket flow (headless password login blocked by Clerk, as expected). Seeded cart with product 7814 in localStorage (also verified the mobile-add-to-cart-btn path works but spec #0 of 7814 triggers a '每月一單特價' limit toast — mint a different spec or user if a true e2e add is needed). All structural/behavioural requirements PASS except one horizontal overflow issue on mobile.

ui_bugs.component: Checkout 聯絡資訊 其他聯絡方式 row
ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 400px the row with select+input (data-testid=checkout-other-input) overflows the 聯絡資訊 card and makes document.scrollWidth=481 vs clientWidth=400 (horizontal overflow). The outer label (w-24) + gap-4 + inner 'flex items-center w-full h-12 ... px-4' creates an element 341px wide that extends to right=481px past the viewport. Visually the right edge of the pill container and placeholder text are clipped off-screen. Add min-w-0 to the flex-1 input container or reduce the label width/apply overflow-hidden/truncate on the row.

mobile_400x850.cart_item_card: name=抖音抖幣充值(抖音鑽石), spec=2980+20鑽石, badge=每月一單全網最低 shown, price=$45.63 displayed, qty stepper 1->2->1 works, trash btn present
mobile_400x850.empty_contact_toast: 請完整填寫聯絡資訊 shown; no order created

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow on /checkout at 400px caused by the 其他聯絡方式 row (data-testid=checkout-other-input container). Add min-w-0 to the flex-1 wrapper and/or wrap the whole row with min-w-0 so the inner flex item can shrink below content width; verify document.scrollWidth === clientWidth.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext stores cart in gt_cart localStorage shared across users; signing out does not clear cart which may leak items between accounts on shared devices. Consider clearing cart on sign-out or key cart by user id.

ProductDetail: default-selected spec may be a limited (newcomer/daily/monthly) one already purchased, which blocks 加入購物車 silently from a UX perspective (only a toast). Consider auto-selecting the first non-locked spec.
Checkout.jsx exceeds reasonable size and mixes items, delivery, contact, coupon, summary in one component; could be split into subcomponents for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — 1 HIGH ui bug (mobile horizontal overflow); every other requirement verified

test_credentials: Clerk tester+clerk_test@shop.com (user_3Kc4MFu2DHwZuy8itp5vS09nzaL). Headless login signed in using Clerk Backend API POST /v1/sign_in_tokens + client ticket strategy (see /app/tests/mint_token.py pattern).
seed_data_creation: Seeded cart via localStorage.setItem('gt_cart', ...) with product 7814 spec[0]; no backend writes made.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile 400x850 checkout flow verified end-to-end except horizontal overflow caused by the 其他聯絡方式 input container. Use the Clerk sign-in-token + ticket flow in Playwright: POST https://api.clerk.com/v1/sign_in_tokens with user_id, then page.evaluate(window.Clerk.client.signIn.create({strategy:'ticket',ticket}) + Clerk.setActive). Tokens are single-use; mint a fresh one per run. For seeding cart quickly, write directly to localStorage key 'gt_cart' (shape in CartContext.jsx line 29-42). Natural mobile-add-to-cart-btn add may hit '每月一單特價' limit toast for the first spec of 7814 — pick another spec or user.
rca of the issue: Horizontal overflow: the 其他聯絡方式 row uses a parent `flex items-center gap-4`, a w-24 label and an inner `flex items-center w-full h-12 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-4`. The inner input container's `w-full` + flex-1 input without `min-w-0` prevents shrinking below intrinsic content width, so at 400px the row's right edge extends to ~481px. Fix: add `min-w-0` to the row wrapper or set the inner container to `flex-1 min-w-0 w-full` so it can shrink; alternatively, apply `overflow-hidden` on the parent card.
